ops.old: Charred yoghurt flatbread striped with za'atar, sumac and nigella, whipped feta, pomegranate, mint and dill. For 4: 300g self-raising flour, 350g Greek yoghurt, 1 tsp salt, 200g feta, 1 lemon, 4 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp za'atar, 2 tsp sumac, 2 tsp nigella seeds, 80g pomegranate seeds, 1 small bunch mint, 1 small bunch dill. Mix the flour, 250g of the yoghurt and the salt into a soft dough, knead for 1 minute, then rest 10 minutes. Whip the feta with the remaining 100g yoghurt, the lemon zest and juice and 2 tbsp of the olive oil until smooth. Divide the dough into 4 and roll each piece into a thin rectangle about 25cm long. Cook each flatbread in a hot dry frying pan for 2 minutes a side, until puffed and charred in spots. Brush with the rest of the olive oil and sprinkle the za'atar, sumac and nigella seeds in stripes across each one, like a rug. Spread the whipped feta on a platter, lay the flatbreads alongside and scatter with the pomegranate, mint and dill.
